title: Lessons with Nickerson and Lorenzo Tio
summary: He began lessons at eight or nine with Professor Nickerson, then Lorenzo Tio, from whom he really learned to read and play.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Yeah, good old days. I started taking lessons on him, about eight or nine years old or something like that. Who was your teacher? Well, first I went to Professor Nickerson because Lorenzo Teal was in New York. And my brother was supposed to go to Mary Perez, and Mary Perez in New York, so he went to Charleneene. And I went to Professor Nickerson. So when Lorenzo Teal came back from New York, well, I went to Lorenzo Teal. In other words, that's my teacher, Lorenzo Teal, because that's where I really learned how to read and play. Professor Nickerson was a wonderful teacher, but he was a violinist, you know. He could teach all instruments. It's not like going, like if you're going to a fellow that played an instrument that you want to learn, it's better.
